newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 756,000 barrels in the week ended June 20 to 322.32 million barrels from 323.08 million barrels the previous week, the American Petroleum Institute said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 2.60 million barrels in the week to 255.11 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 905,000 barrels to 112.63 million barrels from a revised 111.72 million barrels that was previously reported as 112.54 million the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 1.42 million barrels to 38.83 million barrels.
It said gasoline production rose 17,000 barrels in the week to 8.25 million bpd from 8.23 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks rose 592,000 barrels in the week to 205.47 million barrels from a revised 204.87 million barrels that was previously reported as 204.12 million.
Percent of stocks capacity was unchanged from the prior week at 97.6 percent.

API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 1.28 million barrels to 41.94 million barrels from a revised 43.22 million barrels that was previously reported as 42.49 million barrels the previous week.
API also said crude runs refinery operating rate excluding PADD 5 rose to 98.1 percent in the week from 96.5 percent the previous week.
API said total crude runs to processing units fell to 15.05 million barrels per day from 15.08 million the previous week.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 40.14 million barrels from 39.62 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 7.63 million barrels per day from 9.39 million, API said.
